The eighth season of ''[[Futurama]]'' consisted of ten episodes. It premiered on [[Hulu]] in the United States on July 24, 2023. Although the [[Futurama season 7|seventh season]] was intended to be the final season, having concluded in September 2013 on their previous network [[Comedy Central]], Hulu greenlit an eighth season in February 2022. All of the main voice cast returned, including [[John DiMaggio]] after he spent a month in negotiations to sign a new deal with [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]], which assumed the rights to the series, following their [[Acquisition of 21st Century Fox by Disney|acquisition of 21st Century Fox]] in March 2019.

This season has alternatively been titled the eighth season (production),<ref>{{cite web |last=Murray |first=Alex |date=June 27, 2023 |title=Futurama Season 8 Trailer: New Parodies, Old Characters (& Time Travel, Of Course) |url=https://screenrant.com/futurama-season-8-trailer/ |accessdate=June 28, 2023 |work=[[Screen Rant]]}}</ref> and the eleventh season (broadcast).<ref name="1101Synopsis">{{cite web |title=(#1101) "The Impossible Stream" |url=http://www.thefutoncritic.com/listings/20230615hulu23/ |accessdate=September 25, 2023 |website=[[The Futon Critic]]}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Panigrahi |first=Madhuparna |date=June 27, 2023 |title='Futurama' Reboot: Everything We Know So Far About the New Episodes |url=https://collider.com/futurama-reboot-returning-cast-release-episodes/ |accessdate=June 28, 2023 |work=[[Collider (website)|Collider]]}}</ref> This list follows the previous season box sets, which feature the episodes in the original, intended production season order, ignoring the order of broadcast.

| ShortSummary    = Professor Farnsworth creates a simulation of their universe, represented as low-res [[voxel]] models, which causes the Planet Express crew to wonder if they are [[Simulation hypothesis|living in a simulation]]. When Amy inadvertently causes Bender to realize that he is technically simulated, he asks Farnsworth to promise not to inform their simulations that they are not real. They create a hydroelectric generator to keep the supercomputer powered, allowing them to increase the resolution so the simulation looks more realistic, but the simulations begin to question their existence and decide to test it by creating an astronomical event so complex the supercomputer would not be able to simulate it smoothly. They proceed to make a [[magnetar]] explode to see if it makes glitches in the simulation. Bender sends his consciousness down to inform them that they are fake, which Farnsworth warns him is a one-way trip. Bender ultimately decides not to tell them, as the simulations have accepted that they do not care what the answer is as long as they continue to feel. Bender then apparently somehow reboots; implied to in fact be another Bender from a higher level of simulation, and helps Farnsworth improve the generator. Farnsworth reduces the supercomputer's processing speed, causing time to slow down to a crawl within the simulation so it can keep running, though the simulation characters will not know the difference.

== Production ==
=== Development ===
In February 2022, [[Hulu]] revived the series with a 20-episode order expected to premiere in 2023.<ref name="hulurevival" /> In August 2022, the titles of the first 10&nbsp;episodes were announced by Hulu,<ref>{{cite web | first=Amanda|last=Lamadrid|title = Futurama Reboot Episode Titles Confirmed|url=https://screenrant.com/futurama-reboot-episode-titles-details/|website=[[Screen Rant]]| date=August 25, 2022|access-date=August 31, 2022}}</ref> and by November 2022, the production team was aiming to complete the episodes by the end of the year.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Aguirre |first=Summer |title=Young Pasadena artist talks joining 'Futurama' reboot team |url=https://www.pasadenaweekly.com/arts_and_events/young-pasadena-artist-talks-joining-futurama-reboot-team/article_02f68522-5ae8-11ed-b7ff-afbb7e1aa1c3.html |access-date=2023-01-12 |journal=[[Pasadena Weekly]] |date=November 3, 2022 |language=en-US}}</ref>

=== Casting ===
At the time of the announcement, the majority of the main voice cast was set to return, while John DiMaggio was still in negotiations.<ref name="hulurevival">{{cite web |last=Goldberg |first=Lesley |date=February 9, 2022 |title='Futurama' Revived at Hulu |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/futurama-revived-at-hulu-1235090020/ |access-date=February 9, 2022 |website=[[The Hollywood Reporter]]}}</ref> DiMaggio stated that he had not accepted the role in mid-February 2022 as he believed the entire cast of ''Futurama'' should be paid more. He stated, "Bender is part of my soul and nothing about this is meant to be disrespectful to the fans or my ''Futurama'' family. It's about self-respect. And honestly, [it's about] being tired of an industry that's become far too corporate and takes advantage of artists' time and talent... I wish I could give you every detail so you would understand, but it's not my place."<ref>{{cite web | url = https://variety.com/2022/tv/news/futurama-revival-bender-voice-actor-john-dimaggio-1235183272/ | title = 'Futurama' Voice Actor John DiMaggio Wants Entire Cast to Be Paid More for Revival: 'It's About Self-Respect' | first = J. Kim | last = Murphy | date = February 15, 2022 | accessdate = February 18, 2022 | work = [[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] }}</ref> In March, DiMaggio officially rejoined the series after working out a new deal, calling the prior events "Bendergate".<ref>{{cite web |last=Andreeva |first=Nellie |title=John DiMaggio To Return For 'Futurama' Revival On Hulu: "#Bendergate Is Officially Over" |url=https://deadline.com/2022/03/john-dimaggio-return-futurama-revival-hulu-bendergate-1234968435/ |website=Deadline |access-date=March 1, 2022 |date=March 1, 2022}}</ref> He later revealed that he did not get a raise, "but what I did get was a lot of respect". Had he not returned, Bender would have been voiced by a different guest star in each episode.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.slashfilm.com/878158/bender-voice-actor-john-dimaggio-didnt-get-more-money-after-futurama-contract-standoff/|title=Bender Voice Actor John DiMaggio 'Didn't Get More Money' After Futurama Contract Standoff|website=Slash Film|last=Ettenhofer|first=Valerie|date=May 29, 2022|access-date=May 29, 2022}}</ref>

Similar to [[List of changes made due to the George Floyd protests#Voice acting|other animation recastings]] after the [[murder of George Floyd]], several non-white characters originally voiced by white actors have been recast. Amy Wong's father, Leo Wong, was originally voiced by West, and reporter Scoop Chang, who was originally voiced by [[Maurice LaMarche]], are both now being voiced by [[Feodor Chin]]. Both Officer URL and Barbados Slim, two other characters that DiMaggio had voiced previously, are now voiced by [[Kevin Michael Richardson]].

Rapper [[Coolio]], who provided his voice for Kwanzaa-Bot in three previous episodes, died on September 28, 2022. Two days after his death, it was confirmed that Coolio had recorded another episode as Kwanzaa-Bot before his death.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.vulture.com/2022/09/coolio-futurama-kwanzaa-bot-posthumous-cameo.html|title=Coolio Recorded a Kwanzaabot Cameo for the Upcoming ''Futurama'' Revival|first=Jason P.|last=Frank|work=Vulture|date=September 30, 2022|accessdate=August 18, 2023}}</ref> When the series was released, this episode was revealed as the sixth episode "I Know What You Did Next Xmas", which was dedicated in his memory.

== Reception ==
=== Viewership ===
Parrot Analytics, which looks at consumer engagement in consumer research, streaming, downloads, and on social media, reported that ''Futurama'' had the second most in-demand United States series premiere in the second quarter of 2023. It had 50.2 times the average demand of all other series in the U.S. during the week of June 24–30.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Latchem |first=John |date=July 14, 2023 |title='Stranger Things' No. 1 on Parrot's Digital Originals Demand Chart Week Ended June 30 |url=https://www.mediaplaynews.com/stranger-things-no-1-on-parrots-digital-originals-demand-chart-week-ended-june-30/ |access-date=2023-08-09 |website=[[Media Play News]] |language=en-US}}</ref> ''Futurama'' reached a peak demand of 77.56× on July 27, three days after its premiere. From July 1 to August 20, it was the most in-demand Hulu Original and the most in-demand series overall on Hulu. Viewer overlap was high with other long-running adult animated series, including ''The Simpsons'', ''Family Guy'', and ''Rick and Morty''.<ref>{{Cite web |date=August 25, 2023 |title=HULU ORIGINALS ARE ON A HOT STREAK, BUT COULD THAT HURT DISNEY'S BOTTOM LINE? |url=https://senalnews.com/en/data/hulu-originals-are-on-a-hot-streak-but-could-that-hurt-disneys-bottom-line |access-date=2025-08-25 |website=Señal News |language=en}}</ref>

}}</ref> ''Futurama'' ranked No. 8 on [[Hulu]]'s "Top 15 Today" list—a daily updated list of the platform's most-watched titles—on September 14.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Ridgely |first=Charlie |date=2023-09-14 |title=Hulu Adds Daily Top 15, Following Netflix and Max |url=https://comicbook.com/movies/news/hulu-top-15-movies-tv-shows-netflix-feature/ |access-date=2025-08-25 |website=[[ComicBook.com]] |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Spangler |first=Todd |date=2023-09-14 |title=Hulu Launches Top 15 Daily List of Most Popular Movies, TV Shows |url=https://variety.com/2023/digital/news/hulu-top-15-most-popular-movies-tv-shows-1235723904/ |access-date=2025-08-25 |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |language=en-US}}</ref> [[Nielsen Media Research]], which records streaming viewership on some U.S. television screens, calculated that ''Futurama'' was the third most-streamed original series from July 24–30, recording 506 million minutes of viewing time.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Porter |first=Rick |date=August 24, 2023 |title=‘Futurama’ Hits Streaming Chart With Hulu Revival |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/streaming-tv-rankings-july-24-30-2023-1235574280/ |access-date=2024-09-04 |website=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Campione |first=Katie |date=2023-08-24 |title=‘Suits’ Marks 6 Weeks Atop Nielsen Streaming Charts; ‘Futurama’ Reboot Premiere Prompts Surge In Viewership |url=https://deadline.com/2023/08/nielsen-streaming-ratings-suits-futurama-reboot-premiere-netflix-hulu-1235527535/ |access-date=2025-08-25 |website=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Mitovich |first=Matt Webb |date=August 24, 2023 |title=Nielsen Streaming Top 10: The Witcher Surges With Henry Cavill’s Swan Song, Futurama and Good Omens Make Chart Debuts |url=https://www.tvline.com/ratings/henry-cavill-final-witcher-episodes-nielsen-streaming-top-10-week-july-24-1235033091/ |access-date=2024-09-04 |website=[[TVLine]] |language=en-US}}</ref> ''Futurama'' subsequently recorded 349 million minutes of watch time from September 11–17, ranking as the ninth most-streamed original series.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Hailu |first=Selome |date=October 12, 2023 |title=‘Suits’ Finally Falls to Second Place on Nielsen’s Streaming Rankings as ‘Virgin River’ Takes No. 1 |url=https://variety.com/2023/tv/news/nielsen-top-10-ratings-streaming-september-11-1235762560/ |access-date=2024-09-12 |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Porter |first=Rick |date=2023-10-12 |title=‘Virgin River’ Dethrones ‘Suits’ in Streaming Rankings |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/streaming-tv-ratings-sept-11-17-2023-1235617104/ |access-date=2025-08-25 |website=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |language=en-US}}</ref>

=== Critical response ===
{{Rotten Tomatoes prose|86|7|29|Shut up and take our money!|ref=yes|access-date=August 18, 2023}} <ref>{{Cite web |title=Futurama: Season 11 |url=https://www.rottentomatoes.com/tv/futurama/s11 |access-date=March 25, 2024 |website=[[Rotten Tomatoes]]}}</ref> [[Metacritic]], which uses a [[weighted average]], gave the season a score of 67 out of 100 based on 13 critic reviews, indicating "generally favorable reviews".<ref>{{Cite web |title=Futurama: Season 11 |url=https://www.metacritic.com/tv/futurama/season-11 |access-date=August 9, 2023 |website=[[Metacritic]] |publisher=[[Fandom, Inc.]]}}</ref>

Joel Keller of [[Decider (website)|''Decider'']] praised ''Futurama'' for its seamless return, noting that the series retains its original charm and characters even as their relationships evolve. They found that the first episode humorously addresses the show's history of cancellations, while the second episode offers a more poignant narrative. Keller highlighted the essential role of Bender, played by John DiMaggio, in maintaining the show's distinctive humor. Though the reboot may not have been necessary, they concluded that it effectively continues the show's legacy with its familiar blend of satire and clever storytelling.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Keller |first=Joel |date=July 24, 2023 |title='Futurama' Season 11 Hulu Review: Stream It Or Skip It? |url=https://decider.com/2023/07/24/futurama-season-11-hulu-review/ |access-date=2024-09-12 |website=[[Decider (website)|Decider]] |language=en-US}}</ref> Tara Bennett of ''[[Paste (magazine)|Paste]]'' rated ''Futurama'' a nine out of ten, commending its return on Hulu for maintaining the series' signature wit and satire. They highlighted the successful revival of beloved characters and the series' contemporary critiques, such as sharp takes on cryptocurrency and automated retail. Bennett particularly enjoyed the "Dune"-inspired parody episode, finding it both intellectually engaging and hilariously funny, which reaffirms the show's lasting charm and relevance after a decade off the air.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Bennett |first=Tara |date=July 22, 2023 |title=Futurama Season 11 Doesn’t Miss a Beat After a Decade Away |url=https://www.pastemagazine.com/tv/fox-hulu/futurama-new-season-11-review-reboot |access-date=September 12, 2024 |website=[[Paste (magazine)|Paste]]}}</ref>

=== Accolades ===
''Futurama'' was nominated for [[Writers Guild of America Award for Television: Animation|Animation]] at the [[76th Writers Guild of America Awards]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=2024 Writers Guild Awards Winners & Nominees |url=https://awards.wga.org/awards/nominees-winners |access-date=2024-08-06 |website=[[Writers Guild of America]] |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Lewis |first=Hilary |date=February 21, 2024 |title=WGA Awards: ‘Air,’ ‘Barbie,’ ‘Oppenheimer,’ ‘May December’ Among Film Screenplay Nominees |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/2024-writers-guild-awards-nominations-nominees-list-1235831599/ |access-date=2024-08-06 |website=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |language=en-US}}</ref>
